CustomField.description: True once Bound_Date__c is populated. A FORMULA, not a stored checkbox, so it cannot drift from the date it summarises - a stored flag would need a trigger and would be wrong for exactly as long as nobody noticed. Must be granted editable=false in every permission set; editable=true on a formula field fails the deploy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked automatically once a bound date is recorded. It is derived and cannot be edited.
CustomField.label: Is Bound
